description: Hand reconciliation of the generated schemas: limits the server enforces, nullability and literal unions the TypeScript types leave open. Each change names the code that decides it; scripts/contract/schemas.ts applies them after generation and fails when a pointer no longer exists.

reconciliations.why: server/src/work/store.ts: oneLine(title, WORK_LIMITS.titleChars = 300) cuts to 297 characters plus "...": at most 300.
server/src/work/store.ts: oneLine(source, 300), the same cut as the title.

server/src/work/store.ts: an ask over WORK_LIMITS.askChars (400) is refused; a stored one is read back through oneLine(ask, 400), which cuts an older, longer one to 400 characters, the ellipsis included.
server/src/work/store.ts: more than WORK_LIMITS.answers (6) answers are refused.
shared/work.ts: an answer is cut to WORK_LIMITS.answerChars (80) with an ellipsis, empty ones dropped.
shared/work.ts normalizeWorkTags: deduplicated, at most WORK_LIMITS.tagsPerItem (12).
shared/work.ts normalizeWorkTag: at most WORK_LIMITS.tagChars (40), empty tags dropped.
server/src/work/store.ts: links are cut to WORK_LIMITS.linksPerItem (30).
server/src/work/store.ts: an add past WORK_LIMITS.items (2000) is refused.
server/src/work/store.ts: a project past WORK_LIMITS.projects (50) is refused.

server/src/assistant/context.ts builds a source from the AssistantWorkspace it read, so a source on the wire also carries that workspace's connection_label and label, which the AssistantSource type leaves out.
